desc: The new Custom Two-Tone 1911 from Kimber capitalizes on the tremendous success of the 2K11 and carries over several features that have enhanced the performance of this Kimber hallmark. Featuring an optic-ready slide and external extractor, the new Custom Two-Tone provides flexibility to the shooter looking for a classic design style and the features of a 21st-century 1911. The internal changes include a sloped disconnector ramp and the GT Trigger, providing match-grade performance for the discerning enthusiast. Kimber continues to drive innovation forward with premium upgrades that deliver customized features right out of the box.
